title: Perkin's mauveine dyeworks
summary: Perkin opened a dyeworks at Greenford that mass-produced mauveine, turning the 1856 laboratory discovery into a commercial synthetic textile dye.

parents.reason: The Greenford dyeworks mass-produced Perkin's mauveine dye.

title: Cattermole oil-agitation flotation process
summary: Arthur Cattermole's process used a small amount of oil and staged agitation to form mineral nodules that could be separated from pulp by gravity; Minerals Separation later acquired its patent, but found it unsuccessful.

title: Minerals Separation Ltd flotation research
summary: Formed to acquire Cattermole's patent, Minerals Separation's metallurgists tested and combined flotation discoveries before patenting the Sulman–Picard–Ballot process in 1905.

parents.reason: The company was formed in Britain in 1903 to acquire the Cattermole process patent.

title: Spindletop oil production
summary: The 1901 Spindletop discovery opened a major source of cheap regional fuel oil, making energy-intensive industrial production more affordable.

title: Economic Frasch sulfur production at Sulphur Mines
summary: The Frasch process entered economic production at Sulphur Mines, Louisiana, after cheap regional fuel oil made heating the injected water affordable.

parents.reason: The Sulphur Mines operation used Frasch's method to extract sulfur from underground deposits.
The 1901 Spindletop discovery supplied cheap fuel oil that made the energy-intensive Frasch process economic in the region.

title: Zinc Corporation's Broken Hill froth-flotation conversion
summary: The Zinc Corporation replaced its Elmore oil-agglomeration process at Broken Hill with Minerals Separation's agitation froth flotation process.

parents.reason: The plant adopted the Sulman–Picard–Ballot froth-flotation process in place of its earlier Elmore process.

title: Butte and Superior flotation test plant
summary: James M. Hyde installed a test plant at the Butte and Superior Mill, the first froth-flotation installation in the United States.

parents.reason: Hyde's test plant applied his modification of the Minerals Separation froth-flotation process.

title: Butte and Superior's large flotation plant
summary: Hyde designed the Butte and Superior zinc works, described as the first large flotation plant in America.

parents.reason: The zinc works used froth flotation to process ore at a large American plant.
